title: Add Top-Down Shooter game card to User View

requirements.summary: Add a dark rounded card box containing a Top-Down Shooter game launcher above the Single Comment Generator section in UserView.tsx
acceptanceCriteria: User View displays a dark rounded card box with 'Top-Down Shooter' as the title in cyan/teal gradient text
The card shows instruction text: 'Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Click to shoot. Survive as long as you can!'
A 'Start Game' button is visible inside the card and launches the TopDownShooter game when clicked
The game card appears above the Single Comment Generator section
No other tabs (Upload, Live Checker, Admin) are modified
No existing features are broken or changed
The card styling matches the dark space theme with rounded corners consistent with the screenshot

file_operations.description: Add a dark rounded card box above the Single Comment Generator section. The card contains: a 'Top-Down Shooter' title styled with cyan/teal gradient text (using existing gradient-heading or neon-text utility classes), instruction text 'Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Click to shoot. Survive as long as you can!', and a 'Start Game' button. Use the existing glass-card styling for consistency with the dark space theme. Add state to toggle the TopDownShooter component visibility when the button is clicked. Import and conditionally render the TopDownShooter component (from frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.tsx) inside or below the card when the game is active. Ensure the card is positioned directly above the existing Single Comment Generator section without altering any other layout or functionality.
